paragraphs: Morning meetings review the previous day's fulfillment and today's peaks, followed by vehicle and warehouse scheduling. The morning continues with carrier and last-mile coordination and in-transit exception monitoring. In the afternoon, review inventory turns and manage transfers and replenishment. During peaks, handle overloads and delays and decide whether to add vehicles. Before leaving, issue reports and clarify the next day's plan.
